title: NO GOOGLE PROFILE?
*NO MAP SPOT*
slides.sub: Five jobs your Google profile does that your website can't.

title: PLUMBER
*JOONDALUP*
slides.body: Search it and the map shows three plumbers before a single website, and every one of them has a Google profile.

title: IT PUTS YOU
*ON THE MAP*
slides.body: The map pulls from Google profiles. Your website shows up underneath, if it shows up at all.

title: THEY CALL
*FROM THE SEARCH*
slides.body: Call button, directions, hours, right in the results. Dave in Midland needed a sparky at 7am and rang the first number he saw.

title: THE STARS
*LIVE HERE*
slides.body: The stars next to your name come from your Google profile. The testimonials page on your website gets read by your mum (hi Mum).

title: IT SAYS
*YOU'RE OPEN*
slides.body: Wrong Saturday hours on Google cost you the customer who drove to Fremantle and found the door locked.

title: IT TELLS GOOGLE
*WHERE YOU WORK*
slides.body: Categories and service areas tell Google you fix roofs in Rockingham. Your website still matters. It backs the profile up.

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Send us a DM and I'll check your Google profile for free.
